The [[Deldrimor Talisman]] is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[reward trophy]] that each [[character]] may obtain once from [[King Jalis Ironhammer]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)|Droknar's Forge explorable area]] after completing [[Hell's Precipice]]. Exchange it with one of the Artisans (listed below) located in Droknar's Forge explorable area for a unique item.

==Collectors==
*[[Artisan of Light]]
*[[Artisan of Spirits]]
*[[Artisan of Nature]]
*[[Artisan of Illusion]]
*[[Artisan of Elements]]
*[[Artisan of Steel]]
*[[Artisan of Shadows]]
*[[Artisan of Scythes]]
*[[Artisan of Spears]]
*[[Artisan of Death]]

==Notes==
*Added on [[Game updates/20080424|April 24th, 2008]]. Characters who already completed Hell's Precipice prior to the end-game area being added may replay Hell's Precipice to obtain a Talisman.

==Trivia==
*This item resembles a [[wikipedia:Dreamcatcher|Dreamcatcher]].
*It was added with the [[Third Anniversary Celebration]] [[Game_updates/20080424#Update_-_Thursday.2C_April_24.2C_2008|update]].
